title: fishbaiter
description: You need bait to fish. Customizable bait system for the most elite fishermen! Every bait has a unique loot table!
body:
Fishbaiter lets the most elite fishers select their bait carefully and get to fishing. Every bait has a unique loot table, and modpack makers can add their own!
